newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers under 400 lbs were $1.00 per cwt lower, over 400 lbs were steady and feeder heifers were steady to firm, compared to last week's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 64.25- 68.50; 700-800 lbs 61.50-67.10, including 17 head Charolais Cross 719 lbs 67.10; 12 head 1072 lbs 61.25. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs few 63.75. Holstein Large 2 600-700 lbs few 51.75; 10 head 801 lbs 48.25.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 54.00-59.50; 700-800 lbs 54.75-58.50. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs few 52.00.
